answer: Record every attestation with the attester's own history attached. Weight it by that history, so a plume of fresh keys carries near-zero influence. Burn the attester's stake when a recruit is caught faking, which makes vouching an expensive act instead of a free favor. Re-run the weighting at each epoch close, and let an opal badge on a profile move nothing. To win, the attacker must post honest work per identity first, and that bill lands above the sable price of buying the work.
